headline: Physicswallah grants stock options to employees
hook: Routine equity incentive for Physicswallah staff
summary: Physicswallah Limited has informed the stock exchange regarding the grant of stock options to its employees or eligible personnel. Employee stock options are a standard corporate practice used to attract and retain talent by offering equity ownership over a vesting period. Such grants typically have a minor long-term dilution effect on existing shareholders' equity. For retail investors, this filing represents routine administrative disclosures from the unlisted or transitioning entity.
why_it_matters: Minor equity dilution from employee stock grants.
